coverageNotes: Applies the task-supplied backend to a supplied hook component; tests accumulated results and loadMore size. Does not measure independently implementing the backend, hook selection, or complete UI.

questions.concept: Pagination accumulation and requested page size
questions.question: Which three name lists does the component show?

options.rationale: This predicts replacement with the newest page. The hook accumulates earlier pages in results.

options.text: [E, D] → [E, D, C, B] → [E, D, C, B, A]
options.rationale: This treats initialNumItems as the size of every subsequent request. loadMore(1) requests one new item.

options.text: [E, D] → [E, D, C] → [E, D, C, B, A]
options.rationale: The first page has two items, loadMore(1) appends one, and loadMore(3) appends the remaining two.
This predicts a new query starting at the beginning for each loadMore call. The hook continues from its saved cursor.
